current_repo_note: The memory implementation lives in a separate component referenced as a submodule, which carries the same strong copyleft licence as the application.
canonical_data: hierarchical markdown summary trees over connected accounts, plus a canonical entity registry
strengths: Memory is a folder of editable markdown the user owns, and the same files the agent reasons over are the ones a person can open and correct
A local-only mode is enforced where the inference client is constructed, so no code path can reach a hosted model while it is set
Change tracking maps onto real version-control primitives, so a reader can ask what changed since they last looked
weaknesses: It is an assistant rather than a memory service: no external interface, package, or tool protocol lets other software read its memory
A strong copyleft licence with a hosted subscription backend makes it hard to embed or to run wholly independently at default settings
The project labels itself early beta, and its memory core has only just been extracted into a separate component
why_it_matters: The clearest working demonstration that a personal assistant's memory can be a plain markdown vault the owner reads and corrects by hand.
